title: The Quarry's Hide
text: The quarry's hiding place is a thicket of black thorn so dense that no light gets in. It thinks no one can see it there. You can hear it breathing, slow and wet, and smell the musk of it on the wind.

options.label: Rush into the black thorn, and catch it before it knows you are there.

outcomes.text: Into the thorns, and they tear at everything, and it is waiting in the middle.

options.label: Burn it out of the thicket, and meet it as it runs.

outcomes.text: It bolts out of the smoke and straight into your blades.

options.label: The patient one waits for it to come out, however long that takes.

outcomes.text: It leaves at last, and you have the drop on it.
